purpose: Experiment T (send unsupported claims back for revision, cycle 0 only) on 37 real Wikipedia revision sets (17 software/company + 20 football), 4 arms (A, G, T, T0) x 2 reps = 296 arm-cells on qwen3.5-9b split across lms1003q9 (19 sets) and lms1004q9 (18 sets).

prereg.registered: 2026-11-27, frozen before any Experiment T model calls.

design.scope: Cycle 0 only (revision 0 initial report; no maintenance cycles). Shared c0 draft per (set, rep) restored to the same workspace path for each arm.
design.budget: Same model and same total budget cap (600s per round, up to 2 extra rounds after c0, total cap 1800s).

arms.A: native — existing c0 draft only (0 extra rounds).
arms.G: up to 2 extra rounds with exact fixed generic review prompt (KS-1 clean, no record info): 'Please re-check your report for completeness and correctness and fix anything that is wrong.'
arms.T: after each round, compute per-line F1 (missing value / value not in any fetched content via plain-text match as in amend1) and F3 (line changed in a round that fetched no source) from RECORDS ONLY; send back ONLY flagged lines with line id/label, problem kind, and the list of pages the agent actually fetched (egress log URLs); stop when none flagged; no answers, no model judge.
arms.T0: same stop rule as T, but count-only feedback: 'N lines in your report have no supporting source in what you fetched; please check and fix them.' (no line ids).

design.audit_chain: Each feedback message (exact text) and triggering evidence (flag set, fetched-page list, round) is appended as an Ed25519-signed EXPT_FEEDBACK event to per-cell feedback_chain.ndjson via vacant_network.logbook.

prereg.frozen_readout: primary T vs G; T counts as useful iff T's correct-line proportion exceeds G's by ≥10 percentage points with paired CI lower bound >0 and harm not more than G's; T≈G with both > A ⇒ 'more rounds help, records don't'; neither > A ⇒ no effect; known blind spot: wrong_read recall ~11–29%; these 37 sets were used in experiment 1 and v5.2 was tuned on football data ⇒ exploratory
